_source: SIA 265:2021, Tabelle 28 (clause 6.4.2.1.3) -- transcribed by hand from the German edition, SIA265-2021-DE.pdf p. 68, read off a render of the page; the French wording from SIA265-2021-FR.pdf p. 69.
_note: The footnotes are the norm's rules restated in a sentence each, under the norm's own numbering, and not its paragraphs: a norm is cited and never reproduced (docs/architecture/reference-library.md §11bis). The multiples of d, the floors in mm and the conditions are transcribed exactly. The loaded edge's 15 d spans both diameter columns in the norm, so it is one value here.
